item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 5
item.description: In the afternoon, neither Ji Yao nor Xie Congxiao returned to school. After treating his injuries, Xie Congxiao took Ji Yao out for a bite to eat and then brought him straight home. When Ji Mingcheng learned that Ji Yao had been bullied at school, he rushed home early from work. Seeing the bandages wrapped around Ji Yao’s face and hands, he silently cursed a few times in anger. “This isn’t over. Our Yao Yao is visually impaired, and we’re in the right. We absolutely can’t let this slide.” Xie Congxiao held Ji Yao and said to Ji Mingcheng, “Mm, I’ve already contacted a lawyer. The follow-up matters will be handled by the lawyer.” Ji Mingcheng was…

item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 4
item.description: After summer vacation ended, Ji Yao returned to school. However, he was still not very familiar with Braille. Problems that he used to understand just by listening casually had now become incomprehensible hieroglyphs because he couldn't see. He grew increasingly anxious, afraid that his grades would plummet and disappoint his brother, and also afraid of the pity-filled sympathy from others. He had only been away from school for a little over a month, but because he had suddenly gone blind, it seemed like everything had changed. Everyone treated him like a fragile porcelain doll. The only thing that remained unchanged was probably his childhood friend Xu Xingxing, whom he had been playing with since kindergarten. Xu Xingxing was…

item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 3
item.description: After Ji Yao lost his sight, he didn’t want to attend a school for the blind. Xie Congxiao applied for him to continue studying at his previous school instead. Since Ji Yao’s health wasn’t great and summer vacation was approaching, Xie Congxiao simply requested leave for both of them. On one hand, he could care for Ji Yao at home; on the other, he could help him learn Braille. During this time, many people came to visit Ji Yao—his teachers, classmates, and friends, as well as Xie Congxiao’s own acquaintances. The school teachers were aware of their situation. item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 2
item.description: Since their trip to the hospital, Ji Yao noticed that Xie Congxiao had changed. Every day, he strictly limited Ji Yao’s television time and wouldn’t even let him daydream while doing homework. Xie Congxiao insisted that he finish all his assignments within half an hour. On days without classes, Xie Congxiao often took him out to play, bought him all kinds of delicious treats, purchased many new clothes, and even enrolled Ji Yao in extracurricular classes. At that time, Ji Yao had just returned home from a vocal lesson. The weather was hot, so Xie Congxiao helped him take a bath and was now trimming his nails. item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 1
item.description: “What’s wrong with your eyes?” Just as Ji Yao was about to raise his hand to rub his eyes, he heard his older brother Xie Congxiao’s voice. He immediately lowered his hand and turned to look at the person beside him, covering his mouth as he whispered softly, “They feel a bit uncomfortable.” He couldn’t quite pinpoint exactly where the discomfort was—it just felt different from usual. Xie Congxiao reached out, pinched Ji Yao’s chin, and examined his eyes. In a voice only the two of them could hear, he said to Ji Yao, “It might be eye strain. Stop reading for now and rest for a while.” They were currently in a sophomore classroom during self-study. Ji Yao, now…
